last_review.summary: The change satisfies BE-004-01. EventBusService redacts every payload before constructing, buffering, notifying, or returning the event. General payloads are deeply copied with recursive, case- and separator-insensitive forbidden-key removal, while tool.called payloads are projected to the frozen action/argsPreview allowlist. The diff is complete, confined to allowed paths, introduces no prohibited architecture changes, and deterministic build and layering verification passed.

notes: No tests are executed by this loop; build and full-tree layering check are the deterministic gates.
V1 is entirely in-memory. A restart loses conversations, tasks, event buffers, pending approvals and auth contexts.
NoktosClient runs against an explicitly labelled mock; noktos-auth exposes no public controllers yet.
The Supabase access token never reaches a prompt, event, task payload, log or UI.
contracts/ is frozen at 1.0.0 and is a protected path; changing it is a human operation.
